picks.editorial_note: NSF's $1.5B X-Labs initiative adds a dedicated funding call for AI for Physical Systems, signaling a major national push to bankroll generational AI-driven breakthroughs.
picks.title: NSF announces 3 additional topics as part of the NSF X-Labs initiative to pursue generational breakthrough science and technology efforts

picks.editorial_note: NSF's new ELEGANT program aims to translate low-dimensional semiconductor research into U.S. manufacturing, directly targeting the chip supply chain that underpins AI compute.
picks.title: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies to establish U.S. leadership in microelectronics

picks.editorial_note: A $15M gift from the OpenAI Foundation to UCSF's OpenADMET Consortium will build open pharmacokinetic datasets specifically to train better drug-behavior AI models, a rare industry-to-academia science philanthropy play.
picks.title: A Gift to Help Scientists Predict How Drugs Behave in the Body

picks.editorial_note: SRI's $26.5M ARPA-H award funds an AI 'co-pilot' to bring specialist-level guidance to rural medical care, a concrete real-world deployment of AI addressing a healthcare access gap.
picks.title: Reuters covers SRI's work in the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM program - SRI

picks.editorial_note: An international team's protein language model unifying sequence and 3D structure data represents a genuine scientific advance in mapping protein evolution, the highest-rated scientific breakthrough this week.
picks.title: Uniting sequence and structure to map the protein universe | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: EPFL/ETH Zurich's open-source Apertus model being embedded in Proton's Lumo assistant exposes academic AI research to tens of millions of privacy-focused users, a significant academia-industry bridge.
picks.title: Apertus partners with Proton's Lumo AI assistant

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's AWS-powered Innovation Hub unites a major cloud provider, a health system, and a university to advance AI in medical education and care delivery.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: A DOE Genesis Mission-funded project using AI to reason over decades of nuclear waste safety data could materially speed up regulatory review in a historically slow-moving policy domain.
picks.title: AI project reviews nuclear waste safety-case evidence

picks.editorial_note: NIST's $30M+ investment across 12 Manufacturing Extension Partnership centers will help small and mid-size manufacturers nationwide adopt AI and robotics, a broad policy-driven technology diffusion effort.
picks.title: NIST Awards More Than $30 Million for MEP Centers in 11 States and Puerto Rico

picks.editorial_note: FAU's 'Hovering Owls' team was one of only two university teams to clear a 2:1 payload-to-weight ratio at DARPA's Lift Challenge, a notable applied-AI/robotics engineering achievement with defense relevance.
picks.title: FAU CA-AI Hovering Owls Excel at DARPA Lift Challenge
